newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers soften on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers soften on low demand.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market edged down slightly in quiet trade on Thursday on thin demand as some shipowners chose to take fuel needs from South Korea where prices are lower, traders said.

"Demand is thin," said one trader. "Shipowners are taking minimal volumes because prices in Singapore are higher than Korea." Traders said a few 380-cst lots were sold on Wednesday at between $102.00-103.00 per tonne.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $101-$103 per tonne and 180-cst was at $108-$110. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $189-$193 and $203-205 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3093)
